description: Analyze an apartment rent roll (up to 5,000 units with status occupied, notice, vacant, model, or down; market and lease rent per month; lease dates; concessions as weeks free, months free, or dollars): gross potential rent, vacancy, non-revenue units, loss to lease, concessions amortised straight-line over each lease term, effective rent income, physical and economic occupancy, effective rent per unit and per SF, a lease expiration schedule by month, and a per-unit-type summary. Single-lease mode (lease instead of units) returns the effective monthly rent after a weeks-free or months-free concession. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.multifamily_rent_roll@1, every step, and any warnings.

as_of.description: Rent roll date, YYYY-MM-DD. Required with units: leases that ended before it are month-to-month, and expirations are scheduled from it.

include_units.description: Rent roll mode: include a per-unit table with loss to lease, amortised concession, and effective rent (can be long).

lease.description: Single-lease mode: the effective monthly rent of one lease after a weeks-free, months-free, or dollar concession. Give units or lease, not both.

concession.description: Concession: weeks_free, months_free, or a dollar amount, amortised straight-line over the term. Omit for none.

oneOf.description: Weeks free: worth lease_rent × 12 ÷ 52 per week (a week of a year's rent).

weeks.description: Weeks of free rent, e.g. 6. Must be greater than 0.

months.description: Months of free rent, e.g. 1 or 1.5. Must be greater than 0.

oneOf.description: A dollar concession for the whole lease.

amount.description: Total concession over the lease in USD, e.g. a $500 look-and-lease credit.

lease_end.description: Lease end date (last day), YYYY-MM-DD. A lease that ended before as_of is month-to-month.

lease_rent.description: Contract (lease) rent per month, USD, before concessions.

lease_term_months.description: Lease term in months, e.g. 12. Give this, or lease_start and lease_end. Must be greater than 0.

market_rent.description: Market (asking) rent per month, USD, for the loss to lease. Optional.

sf.description: Unit square feet, for effective rent per SF. Optional. Must be greater than 0.

units.description: Rent roll mode: every unit in the property, one row each (up to 5,000). Give units or lease, not both.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms (0 = studio). Used to group units when unit_type is absent.

concession.description: Concession on this lease: weeks_free, months_free, or a dollar amount. Amortised straight-line over the lease term; needs lease_term_months or lease_start and lease_end.

oneOf.description: Weeks free: worth lease_rent × 12 ÷ 52 per week (a week of a year's rent).

weeks.description: Weeks of free rent, e.g. 6. Must be greater than 0.

months.description: Months of free rent, e.g. 1 or 1.5. Must be greater than 0.

oneOf.description: A dollar concession for the whole lease.

amount.description: Total concession over the lease in USD, e.g. a $500 look-and-lease credit.

lease_end.description: Lease end date (last day), YYYY-MM-DD. A lease that ended before as_of is month-to-month.

lease_rent.description: Contract (lease) rent per month, USD, before concessions. Required for occupied and notice units; ignored for vacant, model, and down units.

lease_term_months.description: Lease term in months for amortising the concession, e.g. 12. Defaults to the term from lease_start to lease_end. Must be greater than 0.

market_rent.description: Market (asking) rent per month for the unit, USD.

sf.description: Unit square feet. Needed for per-SF figures. Must be greater than 0.

status.description: occupied (leased and in place), notice (leased, the resident has given notice to vacate), vacant, model, or down (offline). Occupied and notice units are leased; model and down units are non-revenue.

unit_id.description: Unit number or ID as on the rent roll, e.g. "101".

unit_type.description: Floor plan or type, e.g. "1x1" or "A2". Groups the per-type summary; defaults to the bedroom count.

name: calc_multifamily_rent_roll
title: Multifamily rent roll
